messages.author: f31345e547589d21
messages.subject: Warning messages sent to terminal
parts:
Hi,

I'm using Linux. I run my programs in batch mode using :
nohup `R --no-save < ALEXAND_Main_Modele.r` &
In the program, I redirect the standard output to a file using the sink() function, which produces a program execution log. However, INLA continues to send these warning messages to the console:
  *** warning *** max_correction = 25.01 >= 25.00, so 'vb.correction' is cancelled
*** Please (re)consider your model, priorities, confusion factors, etc.
*** You can change the emergency value (current value=25.00) by
*** 'control.inla=list(control.vb=list(emergency=...))'
As I'm running the program in the background, I usually close the terminal, so these warning messages are lost.

Is there a way around this problem?

Thanks in advance.
Regards
DS
